prompts.nakako-torn: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a square inventory item illustration for a Japanese Famicom/NES-inspired detective adventure. Follow the attached character sprite as STYLE reference only: chunky hard square pixel clusters, logical 96x96 art, 12–16 flat colors, simple two-step shading, no antialiasing, no smooth gradient, no photorealism. Center one sketchbook, large and legible, on a flat dark charcoal teal square background; modest ivory/red palette compatible with the game's portraits. No text labels, no UI, no hands, no extra objects. An OPEN worn light gray/olive cloth-covered school sketchbook, seen from a slight top-down angle. One page has been crudely torn out: unmistakable jagged irregular remaining paper stump attached near the binding, a few torn fibers. The adjacent page has faint pencil still-life sketches. The torn page is missing, not a clean blank page. Show enough of both pages and the cover to understand it is one sketchbook with a violently missing page.
